title: Nexus Agent Configuration Schema
description: Defines the configuration contract for creating or updating an agent in the Nexus agentic AI system. All branches (frontend, XR, HITL) should use this schema to validate agent configurations.

role.description: Agent role type. Built-in roles have pre-configured defaults; 'custom' allows full user control.

system_prompt.description: System prompt defining the agent's behaviour, personality, and constraints

description.description: Short description shown in the UI

tools.description: Allowed tool names. Empty array means all tools are available.

model.description: LLM model override. Empty string uses the system default.

max_iterations.description: Maximum ReAct reasoning loop iterations before forcing a final answer

short_term_max_messages.description: Max conversation history messages kept in context

persistent.description: Whether to persist agent memory across sessions (requires storage backend)

requires_hitl_approval.description: If true, tool calls require HITL kernel approval before execution

max_tool_calls_per_turn.description: Safety limit on tool calls per reasoning turn
